title: What Scripture Actually Means by Redeeming the Time
caption:
Redeeming the time isn't a productivity system. Scripture meant something harder than your morning routine.

Ephesians 5:16: make the best use of the time, because the days are evil. That's a warning about what's competing for your minutes, not a hack for fitting in more of them.

Every hour you don't run gets run by something else. The feed. The impulse. Whatever's loudest.

You don't redeem a week. You redeem the hour you're in.

#godlymen #christianmen #discipline #redeemthetime #biblicalmanhood
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
